name: Vestige
author: samvallad33
description: Local-first Rust MCP memory for AI agents. Stdio only — not a hosted service and not production. Causal Backfill reaches backward to the quiet change that caused today's failure. Tools: recall, smart_ingest, backfill. Launch with vestige-mcp or npx -y vestige-mcp-server. GUI clients should use the absolute path from `which vestige-mcp`. Linux on Ubuntu 22.04 / Debian 12: wait for v2.4.0 (glibc). Your data stays on disk.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Retrieve memories relevant to the current context. Default mode is fast hybrid lookup. mode=reason runs deeper causal reasoning; mode=contradictions surfaces trust-weighted disagreement pairs.

query.description: What to recall. Required for lookup and reason modes.

mode.description: lookup (default): hybrid search. reason: deeper causal reasoning. contradictions: disagreement pairs for a topic.

includeCrossScope.description: If true, search across project namespaces. Default recall stays in the user namespace.

tools.name: smart_ingest
tools.description: Store a fact with prediction-error gating: merge redundant writes, flag contradictions, create only what is novel. Local-first; nothing is sent to a remote API.

node_type.description: Type of knowledge: fact, concept, event, person, place, note, pattern, decision

scope.description: Project namespace. Defaults to user. Retrieval stays in that namespace unless includeCrossScope is set on recall.

tools.name: backfill
tools.description: Causal Backfill: reach backward from a failure to the earlier memory that most plausibly caused it — even when the cause shares no vocabulary with the symptom. Local stdio; not a production hosted service.

failure_id.description: ID of the failure memory. If omitted, uses the most recent failure-like memory.

manual.description: Force the backfill even if the event is not auto-detected as salient.

lookback_days.description: How many days back to reach for the cause.

promote.description: Promote the surfaced cause in storage. Set false for a dry-run preview.

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Inspect a persisted retrieval receipt or run controlled evidence replay.

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Read, inspect, promote, or demote individual memories.

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Explore the local memory graph and its links.

tools.name: maintain
tools.description: Run local consolidation and lifecycle maintenance.

tools.name: dedup
tools.description: Find/merge duplicate memories and preview, apply, audit, or undo tag renames/merges.

tools.name: memory_status
tools.description: Report health, counts, model readiness, and store hygiene statistics.

tools.name: intention
tools.description: Track goals and open intentions across sessions.

tools.name: source_sync
tools.description: Sync memories from external connected sources into the local store.

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Prime the agent with relevant local context at session start.
